question: The collegium system of appointment of Judges to the High Court and Supreme Court came into existence by virtue of ______.

options.text: a decision by the Cabinet Committee
a result of three separate cases before the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**a result of three separate cases before the Supreme Court**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The c**ollegium system for appointing judges to the High Court and Supreme Court in India came into existence as a result of three separate cases before the Supreme Court**, known as the Three Judges Cases: 
 
• **Second Judges Case (1993)**
 
• Established that **"consultation" meant "concurrence"** and that the Chief Justice of India's (CJI) opinion was institutional, not individual 
 
• **Third Judges Case (1998)**
 
• The **Supreme Court laid down nine guidelines for the functioning of the collegium, reinforcing the primacy of the judiciary over the executive **
 
• The collegium system is a mechanism for appointing and transferring judges that is headed by the CJI and four other senior judges.
 
• The **system was adopted to ensure democracy in the judicial system.**
 
• However, it has been criticized for a number of reasons, including: Lack of transparency, Lack of established criteria for eligibility and selection, Lack of representation of marginalized communities, Potential for nepotism and favoritism, and Violation of the principle of checks and balances
